quote: Curiosity is the window through which the world enters the soul.
explanation: Keep it open, even when the wind of trouble blows.
long_explanation:
Real education changes how we treat people.

Curiosity is the spark of wisdom; asking why and questioning assumptions allows a society to grow wiser and more compassionate.

Jalte Diye Foundation fosters critical thinking and lifelong curiosity through accessible social learning for learners of all ages.

Read an article on a new topic or ask a thoughtful question about something you do not understand today.
